reuse_only: Original 1.28M completed suffixes; no new MC/DP/path replay
rank_change: A next label changes the checkpoint rank in at least one orientation

quartet_masks.both: U and V each change at least one rank

vector: Original paired 11 plus raw unscaled [F1f,F2f,F1s,F2s] canonical and integrated
sectors: All prefixes and original nine joint-rank cells; named aggregate 01+10
primary: all/01+10 Gamma allocation among the three masks, canonical/integrated; four within-orientation/CRN raw terms
safe_safe_expectation: E_Z[pi_safe(Z)^2 Cov(m|Z,safe)], not E_Z[pi_safe Var(m|safe)] or a fraction of a mean
selection_boundary: Safe means safe in both orientations; even within-orientation B terms retain this paired selection
uncertainty: Same twenty paired original batches; complete covariance appended as a low-rank factor; signed values never PSD-clipped
stop: Deliver these masks/coordinates without scanning finer birth types or running a test suite
